typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	MEMBER_ID  	,MEMBER_LNAME	 	,MEMBER_FNAME	 	,MEMBER_DOB                 ,DUE_DATE	 	,PCP_NAME    	,PCP_ADDRESS 	,PCP_PHONE 	,PCP_ID 	,PCP_NPI 	,PCP_TIN  	,PROVIDER_CPC  from [Data_Exchange].[EXTRACT].[OH_RISE_TOC_Extract]  WHERE PREGNANT_FL = \'Y\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableOHRISETOCEXTRACT
SourceTableOHRISETOCEXTRACT sink(input(
		DUE_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		PROVIDER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		PROVIDER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DUE_DATE,
		MEMBER_FNAME,
		MEMBER_ID,
		MEMBER_LNAME,
		PROVIDER_ID = PCP_ID,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		PROVIDER_NAME = PCP_NAME)) ~> FlatFilePM
